description: This file implements the CoAP client side of the Constrained Application Protocol (CoAP) transport for USP. It includes functions for initializing, starting, destroying the CoAP subsystem, handling socket communication (sending and receiving PDUs), parsing and constructing CoAP messages, managing options, and error handling. It also contains internal data structures for walking and parsing options, as well as utility functions for encoding and decoding CoAP-specific data such as block options and URI queries.

methods.name: int COAP_Init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the CoAP component, including server and client initialization and mutex creation.

methods.name: int COAP_Start(void)
methods.description: Starts the CoAP subsystem by initializing server and client, creating necessary contexts.

methods.name: void COAP_Destroy(void)
methods.description: Frees resources and cleans up the CoAP subsystem.

methods.name: void COAP_UpdateAllSockSet(socket_set_t * set)
methods.description: Updates the set of sockets that should be monitored for activity.

methods.name: void COAP_ProcessAllSocketActivity(socket_set_t * set)
methods.description: Processes socket activity for all CoAP sockets.

methods.name: bool COAP_AreAllResponsesSent(void)
methods.description: Checks if all responses have been sent and no incoming messages are pending.

methods.name: int COAP_ReceivePdu(SSL * ssl,BIO * rbio,int socket_fd,unsigned char * buf,int buflen)
methods.description: Receives a CoAP Protocol Data Unit (PDU) from a socket, handling both plain and SSL connections.

methods.name: int COAP_SendPdu(SSL * ssl,BIO * wbio,int socket_fd,unsigned char * buf,int len)
methods.description: Sends a CoAP PDU over a socket, supporting both plain and SSL connections.

methods.name: int COAP_WriteRst(int message_id,unsigned char * token,int token_len,unsigned char * buf,int len)
methods.description: Constructs and writes a RST (reset) CoAP message in a buffer.

methods.name: int COAP_CalcBlockOption(unsigned char * buf,int cur_block,int is_more_blocks,int block_size)
methods.description: Calculates the value of the Block1 option for chunked transfer.

methods.name: unsigned char * COAP_WriteOption(pdu_option_t pdu_option,unsigned char * option_data,int len,unsigned char * buf,pdu_option_t * last_pdu_option)
methods.description: Writes a CoAP option to an output buffer, handling delta encoding.

methods.name: unsigned COAP_ParsePdu(unsigned char * buf,int len,parsed_pdu_t * pp)
methods.description: Parses a received CoAP PDU into its structured components.

methods.name: void COAP_LockMutex(void)
methods.description: Locks the mutex protecting CoAP operations.

methods.name: void COAP_UnlockMutex(void)
methods.description: Unlocks the mutex protecting CoAP operations.

methods.name: void COAP_SetErrMessage(char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Stores an error message for later retrieval.

methods.name: char * COAP_GetErrMessage(void)
methods.description: Returns the last stored error message.

methods.name: int WalkCoapOption(option_walker_t * ow,parsed_pdu_t * pp)
methods.description: Iterates through CoAP options in a PDU, extracting option type, length, and value.

methods.name: int ParseCoapOption(int option,unsigned char * buf,int len,parsed_pdu_t * pp)
methods.description: Parses an individual CoAP option based on its type and stores the result in the PDU structure.

methods.name: void AppendUriPath(char * path,int path_len,char * segment,int seg_len)
methods.description: Appends a path segment to the URI path buffer.

methods.name: void ParseBlock1Option(unsigned char * buf,int len,parsed_pdu_t * pp)
methods.description: Parses a Block1 option's value into the PDU structure.

methods.name: bool ParseCoapUriQuery(char * uri_query,mtp_conn_t * mtpc)
methods.description: Parses the reply-to URI query into an mtp_conn structure.

methods.name: unsigned ReadUnsignedOptionValue(unsigned char * buf,int len)
methods.description: Reads an unsigned integer value contained in a variable length buffer.

methods.name: pdu_block_size_t CalcBlockSize_Int2Pdu(int block_size)
methods.description: Converts a block size integer to its corresponding PDU enumeration.

methods.name: int CalcBlockSize_Pdu2Int(pdu_block_size_t pdu_block_size)
methods.description: Converts a block size enumeration back into the size in bytes.
